name: Detail Pressing (Web)
implementation_notes: Reuses PressingRecordService::getDetail() (BE service shared with screen-050, see that screen's implement artifact for the service/controller/route files)

Target Operasional table queried DIRECTLY by DetailPressing::render() (PressingOperationalTarget::orderBy('sort_order')->get()) -- NOT part of the GET /api/pressing-records/{id} response -- per this screen's tech-spec direction, mirrors DetailThreshing (screen-053) exactly

Field grouping/order in the Blade view mirrors mobile/src/views/DataPreviewPressingView.vue's detail mode exactly (Presser ID, Tanggal, Inputted By, Checked By, Acknowledged By, Note, grid, Target Operasional table), per explicit product direction that web station screens mirror mobile flow/UX
Route /data/pressing/{id} registered after /data/pressing/create (screen-058) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}

REVISED 2026-08-24 (documentation-only correction, no functional code change needed): the Blade view (detail-pressing.blade.php) already iterated $record['details'] directly with a plain @foreach and never assumed exactly 24 rows, so it required zero changes for the entity-catalog v12 dynamic-add-row revision to PressingRecordService -- it correctly renders however many rows a record actually has, confirmed by grep (no '24' literal in the view)

known_issues.description: Browser (Playwright) spec (backend/tests/Browser/DetailPressingTest.php) was authored but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment -- verified only by static review.
